import sys

def analyze_document(document):
    in_parentheses = False
    last_was_letter = False
    max_word_length = 0
    current_word_length = 0
    parentheses_word_count = 0

    for ch in document:
        if ch == '(':
            in_parentheses = True
            last_was_letter = False
            current_word_length = 0
        elif ch == ')':
            in_parentheses = False
            last_was_letter = False
            current_word_length = 0
        elif ch.isalpha():
            if in_parentheses and not last_was_letter:
                parentheses_word_count += 1
            elif not in_parentheses:
                current_word_length += 1
                max_word_length = max(max_word_length, current_word_length)
            last_was_letter = True
        else:
            last_was_letter = False
            current_word_length = 0
    return [max_word_length, parentheses_word_count]

def main():
    length = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    document = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    result = analyze_document(document)
    print(f"{result[0]} {result[1]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
